lines.japanese: しかし結論から言うと、やつの誘いに乗ったのは失敗だった。
lines.english: Here's the short version: taking him up on it was a mistake.

lines.japanese: 腹を満たしたあとで冷静に考えれば分かったことだろうが、そもそも俺は約一年前、すでにこれとよく似た状況を体験済みだったんだ。
lines.english: I might have seen that once my stomach was full and my mind began working again. About a year earlier, after all, I had already lived through almost this exact situation.

lines.japanese: 往来でとつぜん知らないアホに襲われ、突然そいつが馳走を振るまうと言いだす。空腹に負けてのこのこ付いていけば、ろくでもない場所でろくでもない連中からろくでもない話を聞かされる。
lines.english: A strange idiot attacks me in the street, then abruptly offers to buy me dinner. I let hunger lead me meekly after him, only to wind up in a rotten place, among rotten people, listening to rotten talk.

lines.japanese: 不思議だ。あれだけ懲りたはずだったのに、なぜまた同じ過ちを繰りかえしてしまうのだろう。もしかしたら俺は意外と頭が良くないのかもしれない。
lines.english: It was a mystery. I had learned my lesson thoroughly the first time, so why had I made the same mistake again? Maybe, contrary to all expectations, I wasn't very smart.

lines.japanese: 「お待たすぇー！　スペシャルディナーお待たっすぇー！」
lines.english: “Thank you for waaaiting! Your special dinner has arriiived!”

lines.japanese: ごとごとっ。俺と香田それぞれの前に、アメリカンサイズのアルミ缶が叩きつけられた。
lines.english: Clatter, clatter. An American-sized aluminum can slammed down in front of each of us.

lines.japanese: 「まあまあまあ、八木君も彼女サンも。ほらほら遠慮しないで、くはかかか、召しませ召しませェ！」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, Goat, and your lady friend too! Come on, don't be shy. Kuhahaha! Eat up, eat uuup!”

lines.japanese: 「とか言われても……」
lines.english: “Even if you say that...”

lines.japanese: 居心地悪く肩を寄せあっている俺たちとは対照的に、やつはプラスチック製のロングソファーに悠々とふんぞり返る。
lines.english: While we huddled together in discomfort, he sprawled grandly across a long plastic sofa.

lines.japanese: 「あは～ん、やっぱここァ落ちつくよねー！　いいトコだァ、はぁ～！　ああ～ん、あ゛～ッ、あばばばばァーア！」
lines.english: “Ah-haaan, I knew I could relax here! What a great place! Haaah! Aaaahn! Aaagh! Ababababaaah!”

lines.japanese: 咲夜こと佐久間安男に連れられやって来たのは、爆安の殿堂と名高いディスカウントショップ、その食料品フロアに設けられた庶民的なフードコートだった。
lines.english: Sakuya—otherwise known as Yasuo Sakuma—had brought us to the humble food court on the grocery floor of a discount store famed as the Palace of Rock-Bottom Prices.

lines.japanese: 日中は子連れの主婦、夕方は帰宅途中の学生を中心に賑わうこのイートインコーナーも、夜が更ける時分には、近県からはるばる改造車でやってくるヤンクな男女の社交場と化すことで知られている。
lines.english: By day, the eat-in area bustled with mothers and children; in the evening, with students on their way home. Late at night, however, it became a clubhouse for delinquents who came roaring in from neighboring prefectures in customized cars.

lines.japanese: ところが最近はちょっと事情が変わっていたようだ。例のだっぷりパンツに派手色トレーナー、といったパチンコ着スタイルの古典派ヤンキーたちは、いまや慎ましく隅のベンチに身を寄せている。
lines.english: Lately, though, the balance of power had shifted. The old-school delinquents in baggy pants and lurid sweatshirts—the classic gambling-parlor uniform—now huddled meekly on benches in the corner.

lines.japanese: 代わってテーブル席の大半を埋めていたのは、やたらと沈んだ色合いの不気味な新興勢力。
lines.english: Most of the tables belonged instead to an eerie new faction dressed in exceptionally somber colors.

lines.japanese: その奇抜な集団から滲みでる近寄りがたい異質さは、店内の垢抜けない内装とも気の抜けたＢＧＭともまるで調和せず、かえってこの光景そのものが手の込んだ冗談のように思えた。
lines.english: The outlandish group radiated an alien unapproachability utterly at odds with the dowdy interior and its listless background music. The mismatch made the entire scene feel like an elaborate joke.

lines.japanese: 「つか、冗談だろ……」
lines.english: “You've gotta be kidding me...”

lines.japanese: そして俺はテーブルに両肘を立て、その手でうなだれる頭を支えていた。
lines.english: I planted both elbows on the table and propped my sagging head in my hands.

lines.japanese: 「くそ……だまされた……」
lines.english: “Damn it... I got conned...”

lines.japanese: 佐久間安男当人に悪意はなかったようだが、しかし俺たちが、Ｒなんたらのいわゆる集会的な場へのこのこ付いてきてしまったことは紛れもない事実だった。
lines.english: Yasuo Sakuma himself appeared to mean no harm. Nevertheless, we had undeniably followed him straight into what amounted to an R-whatever meeting.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君っ……何なんこれ、この辺、ヴィジュアル系のライブハウスとか出来たん？」
lines.english: “Hayato... what is this? Did they open a club for rock bands in makeup around here?”

lines.japanese: 隣りから香田がこっそり肩をぶつけてきた。俺はうなだれたままのっそり横を向いた。
lines.english: Koda discreetly bumped my shoulder. Without lifting my head, I turned sluggishly toward her.

lines.japanese: 「知らねえよ。知らねえけど、こいつらアレだ、あの、Ｒなんたらいう」
lines.english: “How should I know? But these guys are, uh... you know. That R-something.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　なにそれ、なにＲなんたらって」
lines.english: “What? What's R-something?”

lines.japanese: 「知らねえよ。知らねえけど、たしかなんか、フレイムバーズと敵対してる悪モン的なひとたちだって」
lines.english: “How should I know? I think they're supposed to be the bad guys fighting the Flame Birds or something.”

lines.japanese: 「うえぇー、まじだー。なんでうちらの周りって馬鹿ばっかなーん」
lines.english: “Ewww, seriously? Why is everybody around us an idiooot?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、そこは誇っとかないとォ。俺たちのハリューも言ってんでしょォ、『過去は俺たちを馬鹿と呼んだが、未来は英雄と語りつぐはずだぜ』なんてさ」
lines.english: “No, no, that's something to take pride in. Our Haryu says it too, doesn't he? ‘The past called us fools, but the future shall remember us as heroes.’ Something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「へー、かっきゅー、誰だか知んないけどその歌良さげかもー」
lines.english: “Ooh, cooool. I don't know who that is, but that song sounds kinda good.”

lines.japanese: 「ってちょっとお！　勝手に話入ってくんなしー！」
lines.english: “Hey, wait! Don't just butt into our conversation!”

lines.japanese: 「ぷひゃひゃ、だって歴史上の傑物はたいがいが馬鹿だぜェ？　腐敗した伝統をブチ壊して革新をもたらしてきたのは、いつだって挑戦的で型にはまらない人間さァ！　ンなあ、そうだよなあ親愛なる腐れ馬鹿どもォ！」
lines.english: “Puhyaha! Most of history's great men were fools, weren't they? It's always the defiant, unconventional ones who smash rotten traditions and bring revolution! Riiight? Isn't that right, my beloved rotten fools?”

lines.japanese: しぃーん。
lines.english: Dead silence.

lines.japanese: 「ね、ひょっとして佐久間君……ここのひとらにシカトされてない？」
lines.english: “Hey, Sakuma... Are the people here maybe ignoring you?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、いやコレは……シカトっつうか……」
lines.english: “Hmm. No, this is less ignoring and more...”

lines.japanese: 「ヘッ！　なァーに、あいつら照れてんさァ。ンなあ、そうだろ親愛なる腐れ性器どもォ！」
lines.english: “Heh! Naaah, they're just shy. Riiight? Isn't that right, my beloved rotten genitals?”

lines.japanese: ぴり、ぴりっ……ぴりぴりぴり……。
lines.english: The air prickled. Then prickled some more.

lines.japanese: 「シカトってか……むしろ睨まれてる……？」
lines.english: “Less ignoring and more... glaring at you?”

lines.japanese: 「だなあ、コレはむしろそっち系だなあ」
lines.english: “Yeah. This is definitely more that sort of thing.”

lines.japanese: 馬鹿の集団Ｒなんたらの中でも、佐久間のようなアッパー系の馴れ馴れしい馬鹿は、異端の馬鹿だったみたいだ。他のどんより沈んだダウナー系の馬鹿どもは、俺たちの席を遠巻きに窺っているだけで近づいてこない。
lines.english: Even among the idiots of R-whatever, an overfriendly ‘upper’ type like Sakuma seemed to be the odd idiot out. The other gloomy ‘downer’ types just watched our table from a distance and didn't come over.

lines.japanese: 鳳ンとこのフレイムなんたらーズみたいな、ハッピートゥギャザー至上主義の押し売りにも相当ゲンナリさせられてきたが、こいつらの露骨な見下しビームにもまた相当ゲンナリだ。
lines.english: Otori's Flame-whatever-Birds and their door-to-door sales pitch for compulsory togetherness had already exhausted me. The naked contempt beaming from this bunch was every bit as tiresome.

lines.japanese: なんなんだ。なんなんだよ、どいつもこいつも。フツーにしてくれ、フツーに無関心でいてくれ、フツーにスルーしてくれ。それが現代社会のマナーってもんだろう。
lines.english: What the hell? What the hell was wrong with every last one of them? Just act normal. Be normally indifferent. Normally ignore me. That's how people are supposed to behave in modern society.

lines.japanese: 「はーあ。帰るか」
lines.english: “Haaah. Wanna go home?”

lines.japanese: 俺は隣りの小娘に欠伸みたいな誘いをかけた。しかし香田から返ってきたのは意外な反応。
lines.english: I tossed the girl beside me an invitation that came out like a yawn. But Koda's answer wasn't what I expected.

lines.japanese: 「エーでも、まだメインディッシュ来てなーい」
lines.english: “But the main course still isn't heeere.”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ？　おまえ、この期に及んで、まだタダ飯いただく気かよ。やめとけって。この手の連中に貸し作ったらロクなことンなんねーぞ」
lines.english: “Huh? After all this, you’re still gonna take them up on the free meal? Forget it. Owing people like these never ends well.”

lines.japanese: 経験者は語った。
lines.english: Thus spoke the voice of experience.

lines.japanese: 「なァーん！　ンなぁーに、ふたりの世界入っちゃってんのォ！　せっかくの晩餐会なんだから、みんなでおしゃべりしちゃ、おう、じぇい！　じぇい！　なんちゃっつって、だはだははー！」
lines.english: “Whaaat! What're you doing off in your own little world? This is a banquet, so let's all par-tay—hey, Jay! Jay! Get it? Dahahaha!”

lines.japanese: だかだかテーブルを叩いたり、どかどかケツを弾ませたり、佐久間安男は立ってても座ってても落ち着きのない男だった。
lines.english: Whether he was drumming on the table or bouncing his ass on the seat, Yasuo Sakuma was incapable of sitting or standing still.

lines.japanese: 「なあ香田」
lines.english: “Hey, Koda.”

lines.japanese: 帰ろうぜ。俺は腰を浮かしかけ、言外の合図を送った。やつは右手をパーに広げ、真剣な表情で「あとちょっと待って」のサインを寄越す。
lines.english: *Let's go.* I started to rise, sending her the unspoken signal. She spread her right hand flat and, with a solemn face, signaled back: *Just five more minutes.*

lines.japanese: 「へーへー」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah.”

lines.japanese: 仕方ないから深く座りなおして、長い足を組んだ。長い足だから、うっかり爪先がテーブルの脚にぶつかってしまったけど、男の威厳に関わるからイテッとかゴメンとかの軟弱な言葉は呑みこんだ。
lines.english: Nothing else for it, I sat back down and crossed my long legs. Since my legs were so long, my toe accidentally hit the table leg, but a man's dignity was on the line, so I swallowed weak little words like *ow* and *sorry*.

lines.japanese: 「あのー佐久間君？　悪いけどー、うちらバイトとか終電とかあって、あんましのんびりできないんだー」
lines.english: “Um, Sakuma? Sorry, but we've got work and last trains and stuff, so we can't really take our time.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー。そーなの、できないの。だから、さっさと豪華料理ぜんぶ並べてくんない」
lines.english: “Right, right. We really can't. So could you hurry up and bring out the rest of this feast?”

lines.japanese: 香田が愛想笑いと共に、俺が男の威厳と共に言った。佐久間はあんぐり顎を落として首を曲げた。
lines.english: Koda spoke through a polite smile. I spoke through a man's wounded dignity. Sakuma let his jaw fall open and cocked his head.

lines.japanese: 「ほわあ？　なにがあ？　だってもう、ぜんぶ並んでんじゃん、今宵のスペシャルディナー」
lines.english: “Hwaaat? What rest? Tonight's special dinner is already all here.”

lines.japanese: 「はああっ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaat!?”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは思わず眼球を、テーブルの上にぽつねんと置かれたアルミ缶すれすれまで近付けてしまった。
lines.english: Without thinking, we brought our actual eyeballs right down to the lonely aluminum can sitting on the table.

lines.japanese: 「ディナーディナー♪」
lines.english: “Dinner, dinner♪”

lines.japanese: やつは満足げに頷いている。
lines.english: He nodded in satisfaction.

lines.japanese: 「ディナー？　ディナー振るまうつってコレ？　えコレだけなの、ディナー？」
lines.english: “Dinner? You said you were treating us to dinner, and this is it? This is the whole dinner?”

lines.japanese: 「あーのすいませんコレ、どー見ても缶コーラなんですけどー。しかも、めーッちゃめちゃ輸入モノなんですけどー」
lines.english: “Um, excuse me, but any way you look at it, this is a can of cola. And it is, like, imported as hell.”

lines.japanese: なぜか国内生産品より塗料の薄い、チープな香りただよう一品。手に取ってみればベキョッと鳴って、材質の薄さをはっきりと主張してくる。
lines.english: For some reason, the printing was paler than on anything made in Japan. The whole thing smelled cheap. When I picked it up, it gave a cheap little crunch, making sure I knew just how thin the metal was.

lines.japanese: 「なぁ～ん！　遠慮なんてノーサンクスじゃん、飲め飲め飲んじゃえよう！　飲んで飲んで吐いて飲んで、吐いて飲んで吐いて、吐いて吐いて飲んで吐いてア゛アアああぁぁーっ！　ア゛、うあ゛ぁぁぁー！」
lines.english: “Whaaat! No need to thank me—just drink, drink, drink it down! Drink and drink and puke and drink, then puke and drink and puke, then puke and puke and drink and puke—aaaghaaaaah! Aagh, uwaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 「や、吠えなくていいから」
lines.english: “Yeah, you don't have to howl.”

lines.japanese: 獣じみた絶叫パフォーマンスにも、そろそろ冷静に対処できる俺たちだった。
lines.english: By now we were getting pretty good at calmly handling his animal-like screaming routines.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ……まあ、とりあえず……いただきます」
lines.english: “Well... all right, then... Here goes.”

lines.japanese: 気乗りしないままプルタブを開けて啜れば、たちまち歯の表面がギチギチする例の安っぽいケミカル風味が口いっぱいに広がる。
lines.english: I reluctantly popped the tab and took a sip. At once, that familiar cheap chemical taste flooded my mouth and set the surfaces of my teeth squeaking.

lines.japanese: 「ぬりい……」
lines.english: “It's warm...”

lines.japanese: 「甘すぎゆ……」
lines.english: “Way too sweeet...”

lines.japanese: 「炭酸きちい……」
lines.english: “Way too fizzy...”

lines.japanese: 「後味わるすぎゆ……」
lines.english: “The aftertaste is awfuuul...”

lines.japanese: 総じて、いかにも店頭価格３０円台の味がした。俺と香田は互いの微妙な渋面を確認し、うなずき、そして静かにアルミ缶を置いた。
lines.english: Altogether, it tasted exactly like something from the thirty-yen shelf. Koda and I studied the matching grimaces on each other's faces, nodded, and quietly set down our cans.

lines.japanese: 街中で謂われなく刃物を向けられた件の損害賠償……がコレなのか。最近は人間の尊厳もずいぶんお手ごろ価格になったものだ。
lines.english: This was my compensation for having a knife pulled on me in the street for no reason? Human dignity had certainly become affordable lately.

lines.japanese: 「んなー！　あに置いてんだよォ、お口に合いませんでしたってかァ？　てかァ～？」
lines.english: “Whaaat! Why're you putting it down? Not to your taste, is that iiit? Is iiit?”

lines.japanese: 「八木君も彼女サンも消費社会のご落胤だね！　舌に過保護なんだよォ、これだから有産階級はヒハッ！　真珠でも喰らってなァ、この資本主義の豚めェ！　ぬぁ～んつってプギーぶひぶひ、プギーぶひぶひッ」
lines.english: “Goat, you and your lady friend are the bastard children of consumer society! Your tongues have been coddled! This is the problem with the moneyed classes—hee-hah! Go eat pearls, you capitalist pigs! Oink oink, squeal squeal! Oink oink, squeal squeal!”

lines.japanese: 「待って。こいつ彼女じゃないから」
lines.english: “Wait. She's not my girlfriend.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……数あるツッコミどころの中、わざわざそこぉ！？」
lines.english: “Hold on... Out of all the things wrong with that, *that's* what you choose to correct!?”

lines.japanese: 「くしししし、わーってるって八木君、ほんとはコレなんだろォ？」
lines.english: “Kshishishi. I know, Yagi. She’s really one of *these*, right?”

lines.japanese: やつの出してきたハンドサインは、小指なんて健全なものではなかった。さらにはテーブルに半身を乗りだし、唇をめくり上げたヘン顔で笑いとばす。
lines.english: The hand sign he flashed wasn't anything as wholesome as a pinkie. Then he leaned halfway over the table and laughed in my face with his lips peeled back in a freakish grin.

lines.japanese: 「い゛ッ！　当然だってばよ、八木君ほどの卓越した個性がたった一匹のメスに完結するなんて、ナンセンス極まりないってカンジ？　カンジぃ？」
lines.english: “Egh! Of course! The incomparable individuality of a man like Yagi could never find fulfillment in a single female! That'd be the height of nonsense, you feel me? Feel meee?”

lines.japanese: 「イカすぜえ、ケンカが強いうえに男前たァ、うひひ、最高イカしてるぜ八木君～！　あんた生涯独身だけど、死ぬまでにねじこむ穴の数はきっと五桁もの大台まで乗りますって神がゆってたじぇイーッヒッヒ！」
lines.english: “Too cool! Strong in a fight *and* handsome—uhihi, you're the coolest, Yagi! God told me you'll be single your whole life, but the number of holes you screw before you die is bound to hit five figures! Eeeheehee!”

lines.japanese: 「ヒィー、イェッヒー！　ブチ抜け制約一万回！　吐きだせ情熱一万本！　うるおせ肉欲一万個！　一万個！　一万個ォ！　万個万個ォ、一万個ォ！　万個万個ォ！　万個万個万個ォ、Ｗｏｏｏｏ万個ッ！」
lines.english: “Heeeyah, yeehee! Smash ten thousand taboos! Spew ten thousand rods of passion! Moisten ten thousand holes of lust! Ten thousand holes! Ten thousand hooooles! Cunts, cunts, ten thousand cunts! Cunts and cunts! Cunts, cunts, cunts—Wooooo, cunts!”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、やっぱ帰ろう」
lines.english: “Hayato, let's get out of here after all.”

lines.japanese: 「だろ」
lines.english: “Right?”

lines.japanese: 「ななな、なーん！　待ってよ、ちょっと待ってよォ、つか行くのォ？　行くなら俺、付いてっちゃうけどォ！　この世の果てまで付いて行っちゃうんだけどォー！」
lines.english: “Wha-wha-wha-whaaat! Wait, wait a minute! You're leaving? Because if you go, I'm coming with you! I'll follow you to the ends of the eeearth!”

lines.japanese: 「キッシャッシャ、なんつったって俺もう、男・八木隼人の生き様にメロメロキューだも～ん。好きになったら一直線！　あなたを追ってどこまでもォー！」
lines.english: “Kishasha! I mean, I’m already head over heels for the way Hayato Goat lives! When I fall, I fall straight and true! Wherever you go, I’ll follow yooou!”

lines.japanese: 「来んなよ。つか俺、ヤギじゃねーんだけど」
lines.english: “Don't. Also, I'm not Goat.”

lines.japanese: 「はああ！？　うっそォ～、じゃあ八木君ほんとはあなたのお名前なんつうのォ？」
lines.english: “Whaaat!? No waaay! Then what's your real name, Goat?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでだよ。べつに、おまえに教える必要ねーだろよ」
lines.english: “Why would I tell you? I don't have to.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｒｉｇｈｔ！　そりゃそーだァ、ジャストァ真理！　ババァン」
lines.english: “Right! Exactly! Truth itself! Ba-bang!”

lines.japanese: 佐久間は二丁の指鉄砲を俺に向け、しわくちゃ笑顔で発砲した。俺の横で香田が憎々しげに「うざぁ……」と呟いていた。
lines.english: Sakuma aimed two finger guns at me and fired with a crumpled grin. Beside me, Koda muttered, ‘Ugh... so annoying,’ sounding like she meant it.

lines.japanese: 「同感だねェ、ミートゥーだねェ～。たしかに名前なんてのァ、ひとつの自我をそれ以外の自我に認識させる上での、便宜上の型番に過ぎねンだって、思うよ？　俺というひとつの自我も思うよ？　思うよ？」
lines.english: “Same, same! Me toooo! I mean, names are just convenient model numbers, right? So one ego can recognize another ego. That's what I think. The ego that is me thinks so. Thinks so, okay? Thinks so?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そんな宗教がかった深い話じゃなくて」
lines.english: “No. This isn't some deep, religious-sounding discussion.”

lines.japanese: 「だよねだよね、名前って単なる記号じゃなくない？　だって名前呼ぶときなんか、自然とそのひとへの想いとか詰まっちゃうわけじゃん？」
lines.english: “Right, right. A name isn't just a symbol, is it? Whenever you say somebody's name, you naturally fill it with all your feelings for them, right?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなロマンチックな話でもねえんだよ。単に教えたくねーだけなんだよ」
lines.english: “It isn't some romantic discussion, either. I just don't want to tell him.”

lines.japanese: 「教えたくない！　ウンウン、ソレ分かるぜぇ～。俺を作った権威の奴隷二匹は俺を安男と呼ぶし、クラスの退屈なゾンビどもは佐久間と呼ぶ。Ｒ－ウィングの腐れメイツたちは勝手に咲夜なんて名付けやがった」
lines.english: “You don't want to! Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, I get that. The two slaves to authority who spawned me call me Yasuo. The boring zombies in my class call me Sakuma. And the rotten mates in R-Wing went and named me Sakuya.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、どれも俺自身の刻んだタグじゃねーし、どれも俺の本質を表してねーよ。だっつーのに、その不信感さえもが結局は俺の主観に過ぎないわけでェ、じゃあ本質ってナニよ？　って話になって答えは闇の中～ン☆」
lines.english: “But none of those are tags I carved into myself, and none of them express my true essence. But then even that distrust is ultimately only my subjective view—which brings us to the question, what *is* essence? And the answer lies in the daaark☆”

lines.japanese: 「なか～ンじゃねーよてめ、勝手に話始めて、勝手に迷宮入りさせてんじゃねーよ」
lines.english: “Don't give me ‘the daaark,’ asshole. You started the question all by yourself, then declared it permanently unsolvable all by yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、つまりこーゆーこと。誰かが俺をウンコと呼びてえとき、そいつにとって俺はジャストァウンコなわけ。そんでもって、それは正解であって正解じゃないわけ、ヌハハ。よって結論、好きに呼びやがれ！」
lines.english: “No, no, what I mean is this: if somebody wants to call me a turd, then to that person I am just-a turd. And that answer is both right and not right, nuhaha! Therefore, the conclusion: call me whatever the hell you like!”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん。よく分かんないけど、じゃあ私、隼人君のことダーリンって呼ぼーっと」
lines.english: “Huh. I don't really get it, but I think I'll call Hayato ‘darling,’ then.”

lines.japanese: 「あそー、じゃあ俺はおまえのこと胸パットって呼ぶわ」
lines.english: “Great. I’ll call you Bra Pads.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ俺は隼人君のことアニキって呼ぶねェ～」
lines.english: “Then I'm calling you Big Bro, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「あそー、じゃあ俺はおまえのことファッションパンクって呼ぶわ」
lines.english: “Great. I'll call you Fashion Punk.”

lines.japanese: そうしてしょーもない話を続けているうち、俺たちはいつしか、黒い集団の白い視線など気にならなくなっていた。
lines.english: As the worthless conversation wore on, we eventually stopped noticing the cold stares of the black-clad crowd.

lines.japanese: いや「なっていた」じゃねえよ。まずいまずい、こんなイカれた空気に馴染んでる暇があったら、家電コーナーに貼りついて垂れながしテレビでも観てる方がよっぽどマシだ。
lines.english: No, not ‘we'd stopped noticing.’ Bad, bad. If I had time to get used to this crazy atmosphere, I'd be way better off planted in the electronics section, zoning out in front of whatever was on TV.

lines.japanese: 俺は最後に３０円前後の味をひと口呷って、残りは音高くテーブルへ戻した。
lines.english: I took one last swig of thirty-yen flavor, then returned the rest to the table with a loud clack.

lines.japanese: 「ごっそさん。香田、行こう」
lines.english: “Thanks for the drink. Come on, Koda.”

lines.japanese: 「あっはーい、おっけてぃんぐー。じゃね、佐久間君」
lines.english: “Ah, sure. Okey-dokey-ing! See you, Sakuma.”

lines.japanese: 「だぁ～ん！　待ってッてェ！　ねー、もちょっと待ってくれたら、もっと普通のディナーおごるからァ！」
lines.english: “Daaang! Waaait! Hey, if you stay just a little longer, I'll buy you a more normal dinner!”

lines.japanese: 「えホント？」
lines.english: “Oh, really?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、いいよ。もういいよ。俺マジでこのあとバイトあるし、そこまでのんびりしてらんねーもん」
lines.english: “No, thanks. I'm good. I seriously have work after this, so I can't sit around forever.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、疑ってるゥ～？　今度は俺マジで言ってんだけどォー、ヒヤ～さすがアニキ、他人の言葉は信じないってやつぅ？　信じるのは自分のみってやつぅ？　やつぅ？」
lines.english: “What, you doubt meee? I'm serious this time! Hyaa, just what I'd expect from Big Bro—you don't believe anybody else, huh? You believe in yourself alone, huh? Huuuh?”

lines.japanese: 「違げーよ。おまえと一緒にいんのが恥ずかしンだよ」
lines.english: “That's not it. I'm embarrassed to be seen with you.”

lines.japanese: 「やーん、でも隼人君ごめーん。私いま超おなペコで、超マネ欠で、超おごられたいかもしんなーい」
lines.english: “Aww, sorry, Hayato. I'm, like, super starving, super broke, and maybe super ready to let somebody else buy my dinner.”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ？　おまえ、また騙されたいのかよ。なにがディナーだ、どうせ次に出てくんのは３０円ソーダか３０円コーヒーが関の山だろ」
lines.english: “What? You want to be conned again? Some dinner. Next he'll bring us thirty-yen soda or thirty-yen coffee, tops.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、そらね！　そらたしかにね！　新しいコレ買っちゃったばっかで、俺は金ないけどね！」
lines.english: “No, no, that's fair! Totally fair! I did just buy myself a new one of *these*, so sure, I'm broke!”

lines.japanese: コレと言いながら佐久間は、左手でエアギターの見えないネックを掴み、右手で見えない弦を掻きならした。
lines.english: As he said *one of these*, Sakuma gripped the invisible neck of an air guitar in his left hand and strummed its invisible strings with his right.

lines.japanese: 「♪ギョイーン！　でも！　ギャギャギャン！　だい・じょおぶ！　ギャギャギャン！」
lines.english: “♪ Gyoeeeng! But! Gyagagyang! It's! All riiight! Gyagagyang!”

lines.japanese: 「♪もう、すぐ、仲、間が、来る、んだ、じぇい！　お医、者の、ムス、コが、来る、んだ、じぇいファッキュ！」
lines.english: “♪ Real! Soon! A! Bud! Dy! Is! Com! Ing—jey! A doc! Tor’s! Son! Is! Com! Ing—jey! FACK-YOO!”

lines.japanese: いちおう声量自体は控えめだったが、激しい縦ノリでリズムを取っているものだから、体中の金具がプラスチックの椅子と喧嘩して、がっちゃがちゃ・がっちゃがちゃと騒がしいノイズを響かせていた。
lines.english: He was keeping his voice relatively low, at least. But his violent up-and-down bouncing set every piece of metal on his body fighting with the plastic chair, filling the air with ceaseless clatter-clatter, clatter-clatter.

lines.japanese: 「もぉー、ちょっとぉ、ハズいよ隼人君～」
lines.english: “Come on, Hayato, this is getting embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 「俺かよ。知らねーよ、直接言えよ」
lines.english: “Me? Don't tell me. Tell him.”

lines.japanese: 「やぁ～ン、直接話したりして、そんなとこ知ってるひとに見られちゃったら、責任取ってくれるん！？」
lines.english: “No waaay! What if I talk to him directly and somebody I know sees me? Are you gonna take responsibility!?”

lines.japanese: 「とか言われてんぞー、おーう。嫁入り前の小娘が恥ずかしがってんだから、オメやめてやれよ」
lines.english: “She's talking to you, buddy. An unmarried young maiden is getting embarrassed, so give it a rest.”

lines.japanese: 「や、や、や、待ってね待ってねェ！　いまね、インスピびっかーん来たからねウン、これァ忘れないうちに出力しとかねーと。なんつっても、パンクスは閃きと勢いが命ギョイィィィーン、ピロロ・ピロロ・ピロロ！」
lines.english: “No, no, no, wait, wait! Inspiration just struck—flash! I gotta get this down before I lose it. Inspiration and momentum are the lifeblood of punk—gyoeeeeng! Piroro, piroro, piroro!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー、だからうるせえって、激しすぎんだよ。やんならせめてポストパンクとかニューウェーブみたいなメロディアスなのにしてくんない」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa, I said you're too loud. You're way too intense. If you have to do it, can't you at least make it melodic, like post-punk or new wave?”

lines.japanese: 「古っ！　アニキ最近のパンク知らないのォ？　や、ちゅーかねえ、湿っぽいのはウチじゃ新生派の管轄なの！　ファーック！」
lines.english: “Ancient! You don't know modern punk, Big Bro? Besides, the gloomy stuff belongs to the new-school faction in our crew! Fuuuck!”

lines.japanese: 佐久間は上下の唇をめくったブサイク顔に、下品な中指を添えた。
lines.english: Sakuma curled both lips back into an ugly face and accessorized it with a vulgar middle finger.

lines.japanese: 「俺ら正統派はノリ重視・オモロ重視ですから、ぬはは、だらだら小ざかしいのやってたらノーフューチャー！　ノー！　フュー！　チャアァー！」
lines.english: “We orthodox punks care about energy and laughs! Nuhaha! Drag it out with all that clever bullshit and you've got no future! No! Fu! Tuuure!”

lines.japanese: よくは分からないが、佐久間の所属する団体にも派閥があるみたいだった。どうでもいい。やつはポケットから携帯電話を抜きだし、ボイスメモ機能を呼びだしながら続ける。
lines.english: I didn't entirely understand, but apparently even Sakuma's organization had factions. I couldn't have cared less. He pulled a cell phone from his pocket and continued as he opened the voice recorder.

lines.japanese: 「音楽だって人生だって、シンプルに言いたいこと言やあいいんだよ。小賢しいテクとか死ね、邪魔な定義はクソを食え。やりたいままやろうじぇい、イェー！　自由・享楽・初期衝動！　医者の息子と俺のうた！」
lines.english: “Music and life are the same: keep it simple and say what you wanna say. Clever technique can die; useless definitions can eat shit. Do what you wanna do, jay! Yeah! Freedom, pleasure, primal impulse! ‘The Doctor's Son and Me’!”

lines.japanese: まるでシャーペンでも回すような軽やかさで、佐久間は開いたままのケータイを逆さま──ディスプレイ部が下、操作ボタン部が上──に持ちかえた。そして送話口の小さな穴を、マイクよろしく唇へ運ぶ。
lines.english: With the easy flourish of somebody twirling a mechanical pencil, Sakuma flipped the open phone upside down—screen below, keypad above—and brought the tiny mouthpiece to his lips like a microphone.

lines.japanese: 「せーのー、ワンツッスッホッ！　あいつは金持ち奪いとれ！　親父が金持ちふんだくれ！」
lines.english: “Ready—one-two-ss-ho! He's rich, so rob him blind! His daddy's rich—take every dime!”

lines.japanese: 拍合わせの用をまるで為してないデタラメ超速４カウントのあと、やつは歌とも叫びともつかない、微妙すぎる言葉の弾丸を連射しはじめた。
lines.english: After a nonsense, lightning-fast four-count that didn't set any kind of beat, he opened fire with a stream of words too iffy to call either singing or screaming.

lines.japanese: 「どうせあいつは人間嫌い！　大学出たって知れてる将来！　満員電車が死ぬほど辛い！　三十手前で耐えかねフライハ遺産くれえ゛え゛ええﾞぇぇーっ！　あ゛ーッ、うあぁﾞぁぁぁﾞぁぁﾞぁぁﾞぁぁﾞー！ 」
lines.english: “He hates all humankind! College can't save his future line! Packed commuter trains will grind! Before he's thirty, takes a flying dive—gimme what he leaves behiiind! Gaaagh! Uwaaaaaaaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 「♪遺ィ～産～　うぉまへぇぇぇのぉぉレガシィ～　ンフフふふーふー　ンフフふーん（っヘイ！　っヘイ！　っヘイヘイヘイ！）」
lines.english: “♪ In-her-i-taaaance! Your leeeegacyyyy! Mm-hmm-hm-hmm, mm-hmm-hmm! (Hey! Hey! Hey hey hey!)”

lines.japanese: 「あ、俺ちょっと便所行ってくる」
lines.english: “I'm gonna use the bathroom.”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃー！　やだやだやだ、サシカラ状態やだーっ！」
lines.english: “Aagh! No, no, no! I don't wanna be stuck doing karaoke alone with him!”

lines.japanese: 逃げようとしたら香田にすがりつかれた。
lines.english: Koda clung to me when I tried to escape.

lines.japanese: 「ちょおー、も、待って待って、置いてくなしー！　隼人君行くなら私も行くってー！」
lines.english: “Heeey, wait, wait, don't leave me behiiind! If you're going, Hayato, I'm going tooo!”

lines.japanese: 「ワンツスッホッ！　あのコはアイツと連れション連れション！　アナタがイクならアタシもイクイク！」
lines.english: “One-two, let's go! The girl and the boy go pee-pee together! If you're coming, then I'm coming too—coming, coming!”

lines.japanese: 「うっさい！」
lines.english: “Shut up!”

lines.japanese: 「♪胸パット～胸パット～！」
lines.english: “♪ Bra pads, bra pads!”

lines.japanese: 「うっさああああい！」
lines.english: “Shut uuuup!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、でも香田、メシ食ってくんだろ。俺ちょっと便所行くだけだし、ここで待ってろよ」
lines.english: “But Koda, you're staying to eat, right? I'm only going to the bathroom. Wait here.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょおウソいー！　だって上着きてバッグ持ってってソレ、めたんこ直帰コースじゃん！」
lines.english: “What a lie! You put on your jacket and picked up your bag—that's obviously straight-home mode!”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ、ちげ、ちげーって馬鹿、ただのションベンだよ。あの、す、すぐ戻ってくるって」
lines.english: “No, idiot, that's not—I'm just taking a piss. I-I'll be right back.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃーなんでそんな噛んでんだよっ、だいち、Ｔ行くだけならバッグ持ってく必要ないでしょお！？」
lines.english: “Then why're you stammering? And if you're only hitting the john, why do you need your bag?!”

lines.japanese: 「いやホラ、あの、俺いま生理中だし」
lines.english: “Well, uh… I'm on my period.”

lines.japanese: 「いいわけまで最低だ！」
lines.english: “Even your excuses are the worst!”

lines.japanese: 「♪あのコはアイツと連れ生理！　赤飯以来の連れ生理！」
lines.english: “♪ That girl and that guy are period pals! Her first period pal since her red-rice debut!”

lines.japanese: 「こっちはもう最低とかの次元じゃねえ！」
lines.english: “You're beyond disgusting!”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ咲夜クン。面白いと思ってるんだろうけど、耳に障るだけだから下品な歌やめてくれない？」
lines.english: “Hey, Sakuya. I know you think you're being funny, but it's just grating, so could you stop with the vulgar song?”

lines.japanese: ついには身内からも苦情がきた。Ｒなんたらの真っ黒い群がりからひとり近づいてきたのは、青い目をした日本人──ヤナポリ広場で遭遇した、あの背の高いモッズ野郎だった。
lines.english: Finally, even one of his own came over to complain. A blue-eyed Japanese guy approached from the black crowd of R-whatever—the tall Mod bastard I'd run into at Yanapoli Square.

lines.japanese: やつはくまの浮いた不健康な顔を、佐久間から俺へ移し、鼻から息を吹いて陰気に笑った。
lines.english: He turned his sickly, dark-ringed face from Sakuma to me and snorted a gloomy laugh through his nose.

lines.japanese: 「やあ、さっきはどうも。咲夜クンのお友達だったんだね」
lines.english: “Hello again. So you're a friend of Sakuya's.”

lines.japanese: 「いや全然」
lines.english: “Not at all.”

lines.japanese: 「だなー、どっちかちゅーと師弟関係？」
lines.english: “Yeah, it's more of a master-and-apprentice thing.”

lines.japanese: 「いや全然」
lines.english: “Not remotely.”

lines.japanese: 俺は佐久間との繋がりを否定したが、青目にはかえって気の知れた仲間同士のじゃれ合いと映ったようだ。長身から俺を見下ろしたまま、冷ややかに唇の片端を吊りあげる。
lines.english: I denied any connection with Sakuma, but Blue Eyes apparently took the exchange for horseplay between close friends. Still looking down at me from his considerable height, he raised one corner of his mouth in a cold smile.

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。せっかくまた縁があったのに、残念だな。彼と合うなら、僕とは合わないってことだ」
lines.english: “I see. A pity, when chance was kind enough to bring us together again. If you get along with him, then you and I could never get along.”

lines.japanese: 「どっちともだよ。ふざけんな、どっちともバリクソ合わねえよ」
lines.english: “Neither of you. Don’t fuck with me—I can’t stand either one of you.”

lines.japanese: 「まあいいや。咲夜クン、きみは軍議に参加しないのか、って猊下が苛立ち気味だけど」
lines.english: “Well, never mind. Sakuya, His Holiness is growing irritated. He wants to know whether you intend to join the council of war.”

lines.japanese: 「はァーん？　うっせえオカマちゃんだなあ、あいつ。歳食ってるからって、なーに仕切ってんだか。ひはっ、俺ァ授業とコンパと作戦会議には遅れて現れる男なんだって、あのオウム頭に言っとけ言っとけーい」
lines.english: “Huuuh? That old queen can shut it. Who put him in charge just because he's ancient? Heehah! Tell that parrot-head I'm the sort of man who arrives late to class, group dates, and strategy meetings. Go on, tell him!”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　なあんだ、来るんだ。僕としては、一生現れないでくれると嬉しいんだけどな。君の班みたいな品位に欠ける異性体が混じってると、全体としての調和が著しく乱れるからね」
lines.english: “Oh? So you *are* coming. Personally, I would be delighted if you never showed up at all. A crude isomer like your squad throws the harmony of the whole badly out of balance.”

lines.japanese: 「ブあーッカもう、何べん言わせてくれちゃうのよ満夜くぅ～ん。だかるぁー、混じってきたのは俺らじゃなくて、あんたらの方でしょォ。人数多いからって、あんまチョーシくれないでくれるゥ？」
lines.english: “Bwaaaka! How many times do I gotta tell you, Mitsuyaaa? *We* didn't barge in on you—you barged in on us. Just because there're more of you, could you maybe stop getting so full of yourselves?”

lines.japanese: 「アそれとォ、秩序の中の混沌はむしろ美徳ですから！　『一糸乱れぬマスゲームがお望みなら３８度線の向こうへ飛べ！』なーんつってコレ、俺たちのハリューも言ってますからねぶはははは」
lines.english: “And another thing: chaos within order is a virtue! ‘If you want perfectly synchronized mass gymnastics, fly north of the Thirty-Eighth Parallel!’ Our Haryu says that too! Buhahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「また都合のいい解釈を。僕の記憶が正しければ、その歌『集合・整列・右へ倣うな』のリリシストは、たしかバンド名義だったはずだよ、必ずしも僕たちのハリューが書いてるとは限らない」
lines.english: “There you go interpreting things to suit yourself again. If memory serves, the lyricist credited on ‘Assemble, Form Ranks, Don't Fall into Line’ was the band as a whole. Our Haryu did not necessarily write it.”

lines.japanese: 「限っちゃうんだよ俺はァ！　感じるんだよね、俺たちのハリュー・そのソウルをさァ！　くはひはは、そんなことより満夜くぅーん、くぅーん、あのねー、俺らメシ食いてーからお金貸してちょモランマ△」
lines.english: “He necessarily did as far as I’m concerned! I can feel it—our Haryu, his soul! Kuhahihaha! More importantly, Mitsuyaaa, yaaa, listen. We wanna eat, so lend me some dough—Himalaya!△”

lines.japanese: 「またか、気の毒に。相変わらず君はそういう手段でしか人間関係を築けないんだね。とまれ僕にそれを頼むなら、まずこれまでの貸し分をはやく完済してよ。話はそれからでしょ」
lines.english: “Again? How unfortunate. You remain incapable of forming human relationships by any other means. Be that as it may, if you want to ask me, first repay everything you already owe. Then we can talk.”

lines.japanese: 「なーん！　貸してくんなきゃー、おまえン家のパソコンの『アナルほど・ザ・ワールド～俺の祭典スペシャル～』ってフォルダに、どんなエロ画像が詰まってたか、バラしちゃうかもしんなァーい＊」
lines.english: “Whaaat! If you don't lend it to me, I might tell everybody what kind of dirty pictures were stuffed into that folder on your computer—the one called ‘Where in the World Is All This Anal?—My Festival Special’＊”

lines.japanese: 「ご勝手に。ご丁寧にもＡ～Ｅまで五段階の評価別にフォルダ分けしてあるんだっけ？　ふっ、フィクションにしちゃあディティール凝ってるよねえ。んふふ」
lines.english: “Be my guest. You claimed it was meticulously divided into five folders, graded A through E, didn't you? Hm. Such elaborate detail for a work of fiction. Nfufu.”

lines.japanese: ネクタイの結び目をもてあそびながら青目は去った。遠ざかる背中を、佐久間はしわくちゃ顔のアカンベエと下品な中指で見送った。
lines.english: Blue Eyes walked away, toying with the knot of his tie. Sakuma saw him off with his face wrinkled, tongue out, and middle finger raised.

lines.japanese: 「い゛ーっ！　チキショーあの野郎、ガチの後ろマニアなくせして、あたかも俺の虚言であるかのように纏めやがった。ひっでえヤローだよなあ！」
lines.english: “Eeegh! Damn that bastard. He's a genuine ass fanatic, but he wrapped the whole thing up like I'd invented it. What a piece of shit, right?”

lines.japanese: 「てか、ドッチモ・ドッチーモ？」
lines.english: “I mean... six of one, half a dozen of the other-o?”

lines.japanese: 香田はラテンっぽい響きの感想を述べると、肩でも竦めるみたいに俺を見た。
lines.english: Koda delivered her verdict with a vaguely Latin flourish, then looked at me as though giving a shrug.

lines.japanese: 嘆息と共にうなずき、俺たちは立ちあがる。夕餉の招待主はあえなくスポンサー獲得に失敗したようだし、いよいよこの場に留まる理由はなくなった。
lines.english: I nodded with a sigh and we got up. Looked like our dinner host had failed to land a sponsor, and now we really had no reason to stick around.

lines.japanese: 「今度は本当にごちそうさまー、またねっ」
lines.english: “Thanks for the meal for real this time. See you!”

lines.japanese: やつはテーブルの上のアルミ缶をふたつ回収して、ぱたぱたとゴミ箱へ走っていった。俺も佐久間に目潰しピースひとつ残し、香田のあとを追って踏みだした。
lines.english: She gathered the two cans from the table and pattered over to the trash. I left Sakuma with a two-fingered eye-gouge salute, then set off after Koda.

lines.japanese: 「アニキぃ、なーんか最初ッから最後までグダグダでごめんねえ」
lines.english: “Big Bro, sorry the whole thing was such a mess from beginning to end.”

lines.japanese: ふんぞり返ったままの佐久間が言った。無視しても良かったが、ひととして３０円分の礼儀として、足を止めオウヨとだけ答えてやった。
lines.english: Still sprawled in his seat, Sakuma called after me. I could've ignored him, but thirty yen's worth of human decency made me stop and give him one ‘Yeah.’

lines.japanese: 「うちも昔はもっと、おもしれー馬鹿がいっぱいいたんだよ。でも俺たちのハリューが方向性１８０度変えてから、こっちもメンツがだいぶ入れ替わっちゃって」
lines.english: “We used to have a lot more entertaining idiots in our crew. But after our Haryu pulled a complete one-eighty, most of the faces around here changed too.”

lines.japanese: 「いつの間にやら、俺らの方が少数派で“原住民”扱いだもん。ま、俺は俺を徹すけどさ、なんか違うんだよなあ。身内でギスギスじゃなくて、みんなでウォォォってのしたいのに。なんだかねえ」
lines.english: “Somehow we wound up the minority, treated like ‘natives.’ Well, I'll always be myself, but something about it feels wrong. I don't want us snarling at each other inside the group. I want everybody roaring together. You know?”

lines.japanese: イカレヤンキーのくせして、一丁前に悩める十代みたいなことを言う。こっちこそ「なんだかねえ」だ。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: For a lunatic delinquent, he sure was talking like some ordinary troubled teen. He was the one making me go, ‘I don't even know.’ I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「アホらし。そんなん学校でもバイトでもねンだし、嫌ならさっさと辞めりゃいいじゃねーか」
lines.english: “That's stupid. It isn't school or a job. If you don't like it, just quit.”

lines.japanese: 「んん……まあ、そーね。ま、そーだけど、でもいいのよ。イヤってゆーのとは微妙に違うしさ」
lines.english: “Mmm... Yeah, I guess. I mean, you're right. But it's fine. ‘Don't like it’ isn't quite what I mean.”

lines.japanese: 「そ。それはいいの。いまは共通の敵もいて、みんな同じ方向見てるしね。んイェス！　ようやくオモッそくなってきたぜェ、って感じでェ？　感じでェ？」
lines.english: “Yeah. That part's fine. We have a common enemy now, and everybody's looking the same way. Nnyes! Things are finally getting interessting, you know? You knooow?”

lines.japanese: 「感じじゃねえよ。ぜんぜんオモッそくねえよ。あんな、おまえらな、ガキみたいな番長ごっこに、あんま善良な一般市民を巻きこむんじゃねえよ。ましてや刃物沙汰なんて言語道断だ」
lines.english: “Don't ‘you know’ me. It's not even a little bit interesting. Listen, you guys—don't drag decent, innocent civilians into your stupid little pretend-boss games. And knives? That's completely out of line.”

lines.japanese: 「たはー、そこはホント申しワケネー。なにせ俺ら、ケツに火ィ点けたばっかでさあ。ちょい、血気に逸ってる感は否めないねえ」
lines.english: “Taha, I really am sorry about that. We only just lit the fire under our asses, see. Can't deny we're getting a little carried away in the heat of the moment.”

lines.japanese: 「いや実はね、ここだけの話、俺らいま報復モードＯＮで、怒りマックス状態なのよ。みんなイイカンジにピリピリしてんでしょォ？」
lines.english: “Truth is—and this stays between us—we're in full retaliation mode right now, rage gauge maxed out. Everybody's wound nice and tight, right?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそりゃ。どんないいわけだよ」
lines.english: “What the hell is that supposed to mean? What kind of excuse is that?”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、後期の作品だけど、俺たちのハリューも詞で言ってたじゃん。『我らが主の聖痕にかけて、赦されざる咎に裁きを』……あ、知らない？」
lines.english: “You know, it's from his later work, but our Haryu said it in a lyric: ‘By the sacred wounds of our lord, judgment upon the unforgivable sin’... What, you don't know it?”

lines.japanese: いや知りたくもねーし、と拒否する暇もなく、佐久間の言葉は徐々に熱を帯びはじめた。
lines.english: Before I could tell him, ‘No, and I don't wanna know,’ Sakuma was already getting more and more worked up.

lines.japanese: 「聞いて、コレまじムカつくから！　あんね、きのうね、フレイムバーズのクソ野郎ども、うちに対して最低最悪の挑発かましてきゃーがってェ！」
lines.english: “Listen, because this is seriously infuriating! Yesterday, those Flame Bird motherfuckers hit us with the lowest, vilest provocation imaginable!”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　きのう？」
lines.english: “What? Yesterday?”

lines.japanese: 思わず聞きかえしてしまった。
lines.english: I asked before I could stop myself.

lines.japanese: たしかに正義を掲げるあの連中は、水曜日未明（つまり昨日だ）目下抗争中のＲ－ウィングに対し、聖戦などと称する大掛かりな一戦を仕掛ける、とか何とか物騒な企てをしていた。
lines.english: Sure enough, those self-styled champions of justice had been plotting some big battle—a ‘holy war’ or whatever—against the R-Wing they were fighting, early Wednesday morning. Meaning yesterday.

lines.japanese: でも結局その計画は、皇帝陛下の気まぐれによって白紙に戻ったはず──
lines.english: But that plan was supposed to have been wiped off the slate by a whim of His Imperial Majesty—

lines.japanese: ──だったけど、まあ、あのわがままエンペラーの気分が、山の天気みたいにころころ変わるのは珍しいことでもない。あるいは、もともと血の気の多い兵隊たちのこと、大将不在のまま出陣したのかもしれない。
lines.english: —though it was hardly unusual for that selfish emperor's moods to change as quickly as mountain weather. Or perhaps his naturally hot-blooded soldiers had simply marched to war without their commander.

lines.japanese: 「アニキ？　どしたん？」
lines.english: “Big Bro? What's up?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いやべつに」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 永世中立国でありつづけるため、自由と平和を愛する成田王国の元首は両軍に対し、みだりに相手方の情報を流さないのでありました、っと。
lines.english: And so, to remain forever neutral, the head of the freedom-and-peace-loving Kingdom of Narita did not carelessly divulge either army's information to the other, and that was that.

lines.japanese: 「で、なに。なにその、最低最悪の挑発って。フレイムなんたらーズ、おまえらに何したの」
lines.english: “So what was it? What was this lowest, vilest provocation? What did the Flame-whatever-Birds do to you?”

lines.japanese: 「俺らじゃねンだよ！　俺らにじゃねえの！　そこが汚ねえっつんだよ、あンンンのニワトリ一家ァ！」
lines.english: “Not to us! They didn't do it to *us*! That's what makes it so filthy, that goddamn family of chickens!”

lines.japanese: 佐久間は二丁の指ピストルを構えると、がむしゃらに乱射しながら言った。
lines.english: Sakuma drew both finger pistols and spoke while firing them wildly.

lines.japanese: 「死ね死ね死ね死ね死ねェ、人道無視したクレイジー・コック！　あいつら、俺たちのハリューに手をかけやがった！　ヒハーア！　レイズアップ、てめえらァ！」
lines.english: “Die, die, die, die, diiie! You humanity-defying Crazy Cocks! They laid hands on our Haryu! Heehaaah! Rise up, you bastards!”

lines.japanese: そして佐久間は軽妙な道化としてあくまで高笑いを続けながら、冷やかな仲間たちの集うテーブルへ駆けだしていった。
lines.english: Still playing the clown, Sakuma laughed uproariously as he ran toward his cold-eyed companions’ table.

lines.japanese: 「エイエイエイエーイ、言うまでもなくギルティ！　跡形もなくデストロイ！　我らが主の聖痕にかけてェ！　赦されざる咎に裁きをォォォ！　わ゛あぁぁあああぁあー！　うわ゛あ゛あぁぁあぁあぁーッ！」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, heeey! Guilty beyond question! Destroy them without a trace! By the sacred wounds of our lord! Judgment upon the unforgivable siiin! Waaaaaagh! Uwaaaaaaaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 叫ぶパンクス。だけどそれは負け犬の遠吠えじゃなかった。
lines.english: The punk screamed. But this was no beaten dog's howl.

lines.japanese: それまでやつを疎んじていた陰気な仲間たちが、ぱらぱらと席を立って、やつの檄に無言で応えていた。
lines.english: The gloomy companions who had shunned him until then rose from their seats one by one, silently answering his call to arms.

lines.japanese: 「なんかー、佐久間君ってさー、小学生のグループにひとりだけ混じって遊んでる中学生みたいだよねー」
lines.english: “You know, Sakuma's kind of like the one middle-school kid who joins a bunch of grade-schoolers to play.”

lines.japanese: そそくさと抜けだした帰り道、香田が無邪気に言った。とくに面白い冗談でもなかったので、俺は返事をしなかった。
lines.english: Koda said it innocently as we hurried away. It wasn't a particularly funny joke, so I didn't answer.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　でもそんな言ったら、カズ君たちとよく遊んでる私もそーゆーことンなっちゃう？」
lines.english: “Wait. If I put it that way, does that make me the same for always hanging around with Kazu and the others?”

lines.japanese: 「知んね。そんじゃ」
lines.english: “Dunno. See you.”

lines.japanese: 俺はストアを出たところで香田と別れ、ケツを掻きながらバイトへ向かった。たまにエアギターも弾いた。比率的にはケツ４：ギター２ぐらいだったと思う。残りの４はいろんなことを考えていた。
lines.english: I parted from Koda outside the store and headed to work, scratching my ass as I went. Now and then, I played air guitar. The ratio was roughly four parts ass to two parts guitar. The remaining four went to thinking about various things.
